description: Grade the MCP servers a user has installed against the HostedMCP catalog: live status, failed high-severity checks, tools changed this week, install test results and newer versions, each with a hostedmcp.org link. Send package name and version only, and for a remote server its host and the SHA-256 of host+path (no query); never send URLs, env values or headers. Example: {"servers": [{"kind": "npm", "id": "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github", "version": "2025.4.8"}]}

servers.description: Installed servers: {kind: npm|pypi|oci, id, version?} or {kind: remote, host, hash}

name: check_installed_servers
title: Check installed MCP servers
